title: NIST Chemistry WebBook quartz solid Shomate and JANAF O-037
locators: WebBook quartz CAS and molecular weight; Solid Phase Heat Capacity table, two temperature columns and A-H rows; both Data from Shomate Coefficients tables
JANAF O-037 header pressure/reference temperature and two 847.000 K transition rows
original_assets: extraction_audit.json source_assets records original cache paths, SHA256 and byte sizes
license_status: NIST SRD copyrighted compilation; no blanket redistribution license asserted
redistribution_policy: Only limited coefficient/identity/transition facts and derived checking results are committed. Complete source HTML remains in ignored runs cache.
derivation: extract.py parses fixed reviewed original hashes, preserves numeric strings, evaluates each Shomate table using Decimal60 and each printed precision; no fitting or smoothing
basis: mol SiO2 quartz; standard state 0.1 MPa; elemental formation reference at 298.15 K
material_match: Pure specified quartz phase only. Sludge or brick mineral fraction cannot be inferred from this source or an XRF oxide total.
applicability: Temperature segments are the source fit ranges. They do not certify phase stability for every temperature/pressure, supply transition kinetics, or qualify a wet brick model.
uncertainty_note: Displayed precision is used only for checking printed evaluation rounding. Coefficient covariance and physical fit uncertainty are not supplied by the checked tables.
admitted_outputs: source-backed pure-phase standard-state Shomate h/Cp/S candidate
